corrections.reason: Visual inspection of Col 1 L01 shows the 2nd order (ካዕብ) glyph ሩ at the end of the line, forming the Amharic verb ይሠሩሉና ('for they act/do [in ignorance]') across the line break.
Visual inspection of Col 3 L28 and canonical Ge'ez grammar (Luke 23:44) confirm ተስዓቱ ሰዓት ('the ninth hour'), with 6th order ስ and 2nd order ቱ.
